summary_out.hypothesis: Pre-loop: I expected shorter window = less stale flow = potentially more selective skips; or alternately, shorter window misses slow-developing flow imbalance with pnl dropping toward base. The strict-subset analysis predicted L7 would admit AT LEAST as many orders as L4 (the 5s deque is a subset of the 10s deque at every decision time). DIRECTIONAL part of the trade-count prediction CONFIRMED: L7 admitted +884 more than L4 (86,973 vs 86,089). PNL prediction direction CONTRADICTED: the newly admitted orders (the ones L4 skipped on 5-10s-stale flow imbalance) were NET ANTI-INFORMATIVE at ~-$155 per 1k extra admits (-$137.50 / 0.884k). This is a steeper destruction rate than L1's +$47/k or L4's +$70.6/k (read inversely) or L6's $98.8/k -- the 5-10s-old flow imbalance is GENUINELY informative for the oracle's 30s forecast horizon, not stale noise as the hypothesis posited. The window-axis lever cuts AGAINST L4 going DOWN: shorter window costs pnl/sharpe with a comparable trade-count delta to threshold changes but a larger pnl impact per delta. The 'stale flow' framing was wrong.
summary_out.brief_summary: afg-b-l7 (aggressor-flow-gate brief-summary loop 7) cut window_seconds from L4's 10.0 -> 5.0 with flow_threshold pinned at L4's integer optimum 1.0. Result: PASS vs simple (+2097.69% pnl) but regressed vs L4 (-12.64% pnl: $950.50 vs $1088; +884 trades; sharpe -15.5%) and slightly vs base (-2.01% pnl). Refinement targets vs L4: ALL FAIL. KEY FINDING: the 5-10s flow memory is GENUINELY informative on this oracle, NOT stale noise as I had hypothesized. Newly admitted orders (those L4 was correctly skipping on 5-10s-old flow imbalance) destroyed ~$155 per 1k -- a STEEPER cost than L1's $47/k or L6's $98.8/k. The window axis at flow=1.0 now has 2 points: 5s:$950.50, 10s:$1088. Gradient at 10s is NEGATIVE going DOWN. To bracket the window-axis optimum, L8 should probe window=20s at flow=1.0 (oracle horizon 30s is the natural ceiling). Threshold axis remains bracketed (1:1088, 2:970, 3:832, monotone optimum at 1) -- no further informative probes there. After L7+L8 the window axis will be triangulated with 3 points (5, 10, 20) mirroring the threshold sweep that closed in L6.
